problem_statement: Build a brand-new About page from scratch at the /about route of this Material Tailwind dashboard. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the dashboard home. Construct the full static page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (left sidebar + top navbar + footer) and reuse the Material Tailwind design system (Card, CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, Typography h3/h5, Avatar, Button, the blue-gray color tokens). The page presents a company story: a gradient hero, a mission statement, a 'What We Do' capability grid, a stats row, a team grid and a values grid, closing with a call-to-action card. It is a static informational page — no interactive controls — and must render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: A gradient hero card header titled 'About Nexus Analytics' with a short tagline, styled like the other dashboard card headers
An intro paragraph under the hero that summarises what the product is
An 'Our Mission' section with a heading and a mission paragraph
A 'What We Do' section presenting three capability cards (real-time dashboards, automated reporting, secure by design), each with an icon, a title and a description
A 'By the Numbers' section with a row of four stat cards (active teams, events processed, uptime, countries)
A 'Meet the Team' section with a grid of team member cards, each showing an avatar, a name and a role
An 'Our Values' section with three value cards, each a title and a short description
A closing call-to-action card with a 'Start a free trial' button
The whole page sits inside the dashboard shell (left sidebar nav + top navbar + footer), consistent with the existing pages

The page must include, in order, sections with these exact visible headings: 'About Nexus Analytics' (hero), 'Our Mission', 'What We Do', 'By the Numbers', 'Meet the Team', 'Our Values', and a closing call-to-action card whose button reads 'Start a free trial'.
design_constraints: Reuse Material Tailwind components already used by the dashboard (Card, CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, CardBody, Typography, Avatar, Button)
Keep the site's blue-gray color palette and spacing; do not introduce a new visual language
Mount the page inside the existing dashboard layout chrome (Sidenav, DashboardNavbar, Footer)
Static informational page — no interactive controls or state

Palette tokens (Material Tailwind blue-gray theme): page background near-white #f5f7f8 / #ffffff, secondary text blue-gray #607d8b (text-blue-gray-500) and #8e9091, cards on white with subtle blue-gray borders (#eeeeee). The gradient card header uses the gray gradient variant. Keep this blue-gray palette; do not introduce new brand colors.

Section headings must use these exact labels rendered as Typography headings (h3/h5 per the design system): 'About Nexus Analytics', 'Our Mission', 'What We Do', 'By the Numbers', 'Meet the Team', 'Our Values'. The closing call-to-action card must contain a button labelled 'Start a free trial'.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /about 是空 route (element={<></>}), 不走 catch-all 重定向; reference 从零实现完整 About 页; bad 在 reference 基础上删掉必需的 'Meet the Team' section (h3 'Meet the Team' 不再出现), 只失 dom_assertions + completion_text_signals 门。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。route 顶层挂载, 无 basename/vite base, 故 state_plan path 为 /about。T1: 纯静态页, 无交互, dom_assertions only.
